description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Georgia Institute of Technology seeks an Application Developer (Designer) to design, develop, and maintain software applications that support institutional goals and user needs. The role works with stakeholders to define requirements, build and maintain applications, and improve functionality, performance, accessibility, and user experience.
Application Developer (Designer) building and maintaining applications, designing responsive UX/UI, and creating accessible digital content and marketing visuals

Responsibilities:
• Participate in system analysis, definition and design
• Develop, test and implement technical solutions
• Modify and maintain existing applications
• Prepare technical, operational and user related documentation in support of applications
• Provide technical support and training to functional users
• Perform other duties as assigned
• Work with end user clients and production personnel in conceptualizing and defining graphic design requirements
• Design responsive user interface layouts while ensuring the content logically flows from one step to the next
• Work with other developers and stakeholders to realize designs into real digital applications
• Prepare digital designs, artwork, and other supporting visual projects to aid with marketing and branding
• Evaluate and remediate digital content for accessibility (ICT) and positive user experience (UX)

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Up to two years of job related experience
• This job requires basic skills in application of query language, web development tools, procedural development tools, relational databases, structured programming and understanding of the software development life cycle
• Strong knowledge of graphic and digital design principles and processes; strong understanding of latest web development cycle and programming techniques
• Strong ability to manage and maintain effective working relationships with diverse population, ability to perform and effectively make important decisions under pressure

Preferred:
• Working knowledge of WCAG accessibility guidelines
